bb.name: Coordinator
bb.description: Experimental: it may break with a bb update. Start a long-lived coordinating thread for a body of work, and let it hand each piece to a crew thread. Open its panel in the navigation rail and press New: bb's own new-thread composer opens, already set to a fresh worktree and auto permissions, and the goal you type starts the thread. It plans, keeps its memory in a folder of markdown files on the bb server, and starts crews: child threads that each work on their own branch, on its provider and model unless you pick others, from its brief and done-criteria, with the crew rules and the memory index in their first message. Told to propose crews and wait, it saves them as drafts instead, for you to edit and start. It messages, reads and closes its crews. A crew ends its work with one handoff (done, blocked or gave up, with what it did, its evidence, concerns, deviations and findings), stored whole. The plugin then wakes the coordinating thread with a short message that names what happened and never quotes a crew, and its catch-up returns every update in full; it is also woken when a crew fails, waits on you or stops without a handoff, and when you save a memory file. Its Board, a tab in the thread and a page in the panel, shows its digest and every crew under Needs you, Ready for review, Working, Idle or Done, live, each linked to its thread; a done handoff waits under Ready for review as Unverified, a blocked one under Needs you, and a draft under Needs you with Start and Edit, which opens its brief, model and environment in bb's composer and its done-criteria as a list. Each row in the panel also opens a Memory editor over the same files; every write names the version it replaces, so neither you nor the thread can silently overwrite the other.
